scope: Broad search followed by applicability review; not a systematic complete literature survey or a reproduction leaderboard.
technical_claim_policy: Use author papers/code or official engineering sources for technical claims. Community first-hand experience is marked anecdotal and used as a diagnostic lead only.

entries.name: Dynamic-in-Few-Step
entries.applicability_and_limit: Joint pruning/few-step rollout-distribution objective; distinct from independent local FFN reconstruction.
entries.review_depth: Read method/rollout sections; no implementation reproduced.

entries.name: PPCL
entries.applicability_and_limit: Contiguous-layer supervision motivates transported/window target. Does not justify arbitrary Wan layer removal.
entries.review_depth: Read contiguous and width sections; no reproduction.

entries.name: TinyFusion
entries.applicability_and_limit: Recoverability and masked KD; model/scale/training differ from frozen Wan.
entries.review_depth: Author README/training recipe inspected, no run.

entries.name: OBS-Diff
entries.applicability_and_limit: Diffusion-aware Hessian and N:M/FFN sparsity baseline. Original temporal weighting cannot be assumed right for four steps.
entries.review_depth: Author overview/code entry and paper abstract; not ported.

entries.name: OBS-Diff paper
entries.applicability_and_limit: Confirms supported pruning granularities; not accuracy evidence for current native HiF4.
entries.review_depth: Abstract verified, detailed kernels not audited.

entries.name: Ampere sparse Tensor Cores
entries.applicability_and_limit: A100 BF162of4 hardware supports both FFN matrices; advertised throughput is not full FFN timing.
entries.review_depth: Hardware mechanism checked; installed environment also inspected.

entries.name: PyTorch semi-structured sparsity
entries.applicability_and_limit: Conversion, sparse-linear interface and performance boundary. Online docs version differs from installed2.10; local source governs the probes.
entries.review_depth: Local torch2.10 source bound and two synthetic shape runs performed.

entries.name: LightWan2.2-A14B
entries.applicability_and_limit: Phased objectives/QAT/kernel co-design. New NVFP4/Blackwell/sparse-attention model differs from current checkpoint.
entries.review_depth: Read staged training and quantization sections; no checkpoint substitution.

entries.name: SVDQuant/Nunchaku
entries.applicability_and_limit: Auxiliary-branch memory traffic/fusion is a real cost. Quantization-error low rank is not proof of pruned-neuron recovery.
entries.review_depth: Author mechanism and kernel-fusion sections read; no import of its reported speed.

entries.name: TARDIS
entries.applicability_and_limit: Known affine backbone/nonlinear fallback family. LLM acceptance, prediction and numerical boundaries differ; existingR2 backlog.
entries.review_depth: Abstract and original method excerpts; no Wan feasibility established.

entries.name: DisCa
entries.applicability_and_limit: Learnable cached-feature predictor and distillation-compatible training; exposes training requirements.
entries.review_depth: Author overview/training mechanism read, Hunyuan implementation not reproduced.

entries.name: TeaCache
entries.applicability_and_limit: Cached historical outputs with content-based decisions; not automatically effective on four-step dual experts.
entries.review_depth: Author overview; code/model branches not fully audited.

entries.name: TaylorSeer
entries.applicability_and_limit: Temporal forecast requires historical information; scoped expert cold start remains.
entries.review_depth: Author abstract/source read during this continuing review, no run.

entries.name: AutoTarget
entries.applicability_and_limit: Few-step solver-facing cache targets and valid conversion; different from internal FFN cache.
entries.review_depth: Method checked in preceding continuation; no reproduction.

entries.name: ConvRot author issue
entries.applicability_and_limit: Author reports AdaLN/fusion and row-outlier caveats in DiT rotation. Do not transfer LLM invariance blindly.
entries.review_depth: Proposal inspected as a lead, its measurements not independently verified.

entries.name: CentriQ
entries.applicability_and_limit: Mean-centering is a new quantization lead, not evidence that half-width pruning is solved.
entries.review_depth: Abstract only; no verified folding implementation or adoption.

entries.name: LightX2V cache documentation
entries.applicability_and_limit: Different cache strategies/model/hardware boundaries; documented multi-step speeds cannot serve as current FFN results.
entries.review_depth: Documentation reviewed, no new cache run.

entries.name: MLX TeaCache distilled schedules
entries.applicability_and_limit: Firsthand zero-skip/compile-avoidance discussion shows need to separate algorithm from wrapper speed. Different models and Apple hardware.
entries.review_depth: Author README only, anecdotal cross-platform lead, not Wan evidence.

entries.name: Wan blurred LoRA workflow
entries.applicability_and_limit: Workflow incompatibilities can cause blur; compare against pinned assets/no-op first. No scientific pruning evidence.
entries.review_depth: Read firsthand discussion; no tuning adopted.

entries.name: Wan4step release/settings discussion
entries.applicability_and_limit: Different LoRA versions/schedulers/settings must not be pooled; check author recommendations against exact checkpoint.
entries.review_depth: Community discussion and official release checked; no candidate-only schedule change.

entries.name: Official Wan2.2-Lightning
entries.applicability_and_limit: Release/checkpoint lineage distinguishes four-step generation from sparse-FFN acceleration.
entries.review_depth: Author overview/release history read; original model binding retained.

local_implementation_work: Separate two synthetic installed-backend probes; no external method reproduced on actual Wan model weights.
search_limitations: Search relevance is not evidence of effectiveness.
Some sources only read at abstract/overview level, explicitly marked.
No accuracy/speed table comparing incompatible published denominators.
No automatic eligibility from prior art or hardware support.
